subject: Additional assessment measures for IRT bifactor

messages.author: 441100723bef0cf8
messages.subject: Additional assessment measures for IRT bifactor
parts:
Hello

I was wondering if it would be possible to implement some function that provides evaluation measures of a bifactor IRT model as explained common variance (ECV) index and item-level ECV, as mentioned in:

Toland, M. D., Sulis, I., Giambona, F., Porcu, M., & Campbell, J. M. (2017). Introduction to bifactor polytomous item response theory analysis. Journal of School Psychology, 60, 41–63. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jsp.2016.11.001

Thank you for your attention

messages.author: 9856907c817cbce8
messages.subject: Re: Additional assessment measures for IRT bifactor
parts:
Brian,
I use the Bifactor Indices Calculator package, specifically the bifactorIndices function. This works well with output from the mirt package and will give you the ECV and PUC statistics to see if the general factor is "unidimensional enough."
They stopped making updates to the package so you have to go to the archives. The link is below. Hope this helps.

https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/BifactorIndicesCalculator/
-Gene
